# Green's Brickwork & Building

## About
Green's Brickwork & Building is an experienced bricklaying and building company based just outside Basingstoke, close to Odiham and Hook in Hampshire, England. The business has over 20 years of experience in brickwork, flint work, stonework and building works across Hampshire, Berkshire and Surrey.

## Services
- House extensions (single and double storey)
- New build houses and private residential projects
- Brickwork and remedial brickwork
- Brick matching on period and listed properties
- Flint work and knapped flint
- Stonework
- Garden walls, boundary walls and pillars
- Contractor-led and developer projects

## Areas served
Based near Odiham and Hook, serving:
- North Hampshire: Basingstoke, Hook, Odiham, Hartley Wintney, Tadley, Kingsclere, Overton, Whitchurch, Fleet, Farnham
- Central and south Hampshire: Winchester, Andover, Alton, Romsey, Stockbridge, Petersfield
- Berkshire: Reading, Newbury, Hungerford, Wokingham, Bracknell, Maidenhead, Windsor
- Surrey and borders: Guildford, Woking, Camberley, Aldershot, Farnborough, Yateley
- London and further afield for selected projects
